card.name: Words just before a dose amount
card.fires_on: Words and spaces in dosing text where a quantity is about to be named, such as after 'Exceeding', 'amounts that are', 'at a', or 'units per'. The next word is likely an amount, rate or level.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: A space or unit word right before a dose figure is stated.
modes.example: Daily Doses Exceeding<< >>27 mg : May increase risk for

modes.label: Amount-style nouns
modes.description: Words like rate, levels, daily or large that stand in for how much of a substance is given.
modes.example: glucose solution at a<< rate>> which will maintain the blood glucose at a

modes.label: Partway through a dose phrase
modes.description: Unit or dose pieces in the middle of a dose expression.
modes.example: or 400 units<< per>> kilogram for those estimated to last longer

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying 'amount' or 'quantity' next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say how much of a drug or substance is involved.
